artifact_observations.reasoning: The handwritten text on the pink label is illegible and nonsensical, resembling AI-generated pseudo-handwriting rather than coherent characters. While this mimics real-world messy handwriting, the specific glyph structures are malformed.
Slight softness and lack of sharp specular highlights on some edges of the transparent plastic, giving it a slightly 'waxy' or melted appearance rather than crisp hard plastic reflections.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a cassette and not a similar rectangular object.
To analyze the legibility and structure of the handwritten text on the pink label, checking for AI text artifacts.
To verify the structural integrity of the transparent casing and ensure no fusion between internal spools and the shell.
To assess overall sharpness, lighting consistency, and detect subtle texture anomalies in the plastic material.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of handwritten text on the label
Sharpness and realism of transparent plastic reflections and refractions
Structural separation between internal spools and outer casing
Accuracy of molded details (screw holes, guides) on the plastic shell
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the pink label. AI often struggles with handwritten text, producing gibberish that looks plausible at a glance but fails character-level inspection. Also, scrutinize the transparent plastic edges for realistic refraction and reflection; AI generators often smear these boundaries. Check if the internal spools look physically connected to the rest of the mechanism or if they float.
